rule_outs: Dwelling 9 m from the best section
summary: Flat kerb on wide Hawken Drive with homes about 20 m back.
reasons: Busy collector road, few parked cars

drivers.seclusion: Homes on the same side: 24 m (at 95 m and 119 m) but 8 m at 126 m and 9 m at 91 m; houses and gardens line the whole kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed road with a parking lane; cars visible parked on this kerb, so room to stop.
drivers.traffic: Collector road with steady through traffic.
drivers.convention: Signed 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted; a few cars park here.

flags: Homes within 25 m on the same side
sun_shade: Open, with some shade from street trees; sun from the south side across the road.

best_section.where: Hawken Drive north kerb, in the gap between two house frontages
